derivative contracts<br></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Roboto Light',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:140%">Net gain (loss) on undesignated commodity derivative The net gain (loss) is reported outside of segment operating results until such time that the underlying exposure is recognized in the segment operating results.
